mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger recessionary fears, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months indicate weakening consumer demand that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing supply chain disruption that increases inflation expectations and reduces equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals robust household spending that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS increases for three consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,400,000 units in a month, it indicates accelerating residential construction that boosts economic growth expectations, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1400.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL above 3.0% and FEDFUNDS above 2.5% signal active monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% for two consecutive months indicates labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate hiring, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
